Artist: Label of a text field: who performs or wrote the song.
BPM: Short for beats per minute. Label beside a number.
Channels with changed volume, pan, rever: {{v0}} = how many channels. Keep the number at the end.
Comparing notes…: In progress: Orfeo is comparing the notes of two versions of a song.
Copy bars: Button, a command. Copies bar lines and tempo from another version of the song.
Copyright: Label. Copyright text stored in the MIDI file.
Delete & Save: Button, a command. Saves the song without the tracks listed.
Discard: Button, a command. Throws away unsaved changes.
Key: Musical key of the song, such as C minor. Not a key on the keyboard.
Load File: Button, a command. Opens the file.
Orfeo History: Heading. The list of changes Orfeo made to this file.
Original: The first version of a file, before Orfeo saved edited copies. Shown next to v1, v2.
Rebuild tempo: Button, a command. The user taps the tempo of the whole song again.
Reset: Button, a command. Goes back to how it was.
Reset Note Editor: Heading of a question. Note Editor is the name of a tool.
Reset tempo: Heading and button. Goes back to the tempo stored in the file.
Save & Reload: Button, a command. Saves, then opens the saved song again.
Save as MID: Button, a command. MID is the file type: keep it as it is.
Song: Label of a text field: the title of the song.
Song is required: Error. The song title field is empty.
This session {{v0}}. Save before opening: {{v0}} = a list of changes, always in English, such as "renamed 2 tracks".
Time: Time signature of the song, such as 4/4. Not clock time.
Tracks: The instrument parts in a song.
bpm: Short for beats per minute, shown after a number.
{{v0}}% same notes: {{v0}} = how much two versions of a song match, as a number.
